At age 8, muscle biopsy showed mitochondrial myopathy of pleoconial type. At age 24, had sudden syncope. At age 26, had stroke with general weakness, aphagia, and dysarthria. On examination: laterally dislocated patella, moderate effusion, pain on palpation around medial patellofemoral ligament, range of movement reduced to extension-flexion of 0/10/60 degrees, ligamentous tests unremarkable. Two weeks later: complained of intermittent locking in left knee, had joint effusion and palpable loose body under patella.

data.diagnosis: Traumatic lateral patellar dislocation with osteochondral fracture and intra-articular loose body

Acute inability to bear weight due to pain
symptoms_not_in_common: None clearly atypical given the history and findings
